label: A/B compartment analysis
definition: Classify genomic regions into transcriptionally active (A) or inactive (B) compartments from chromatin contact matrix data.

label: Admixture analysis
definition: Quantify ancestry proportions from distinct source populations in admixed individuals using genome-wide variant data.

label: Alpha diversity analysis
definition: Quantify species richness and evenness within a single microbial community sample.

label: Ambient RNA correction
definition: Estimate and remove background RNA contamination from lysed cells in droplet-based single-cell libraries.

label: Amplicon sequence analysis
definition: End-to-end processing of marker-gene amplicon sequencing data, including primer trimming, quality filtering, denoising, and taxonomic assignment.

label: Batch effect correction
definition: Remove technical variation from molecular data attributable to batch, platform, or processing differences while preserving biological signal.

label: Beta diversity analysis
definition: Compare microbial community composition between samples using ecological distance or dissimilarity metrics.

label: Biological sequence embedding
definition: Generate dense vector representations of biological sequences using a trained language model or encoder.

label: Cell barcode correction
definition: Identify and correct sequencing errors in cell barcodes to accurately assign reads to their cell of origin.

label: Cell-cell communication analysis
definition: Infer intercellular signaling interactions by identifying co-expression of ligand-receptor gene pairs across cell populations from single-cell or spatial transcriptomic data.

label: Cell clustering
definition: Group cells into discrete clusters based on similarity of their molecular profiles.

label: Cell type annotation
definition: Assign cell type identities to cells or clusters using marker gene expression, reference atlases, or automated classifiers.

label: Cell type deconvolution
definition: Estimate the cell type composition of bulk tissue samples using single-cell or cell-type-specific expression signatures.

label: Chromatin accessibility analysis
definition: Quantify open chromatin regions genome-wide from ATAC-seq or DNase-seq data, including peak calling and accessibility scoring.

label: Chromatin conformation analysis
definition: Process and analyze chromosome conformation capture data to characterize the spatial organization of the genome.

label: Chromatin loop calling
definition: Detect focal long-range chromatin interactions between pairs of genomic loci from contact map data.

label: Chromatin organization analysis
definition: Analysis of chromatin three-dimensional organization, including genome folding, accessibility, and long-range regulatory interactions.

label: Contact matrix normalization
definition: Correct systematic biases in chromatin contact matrices, including distance-dependent decay, GC content, and mappability.

label: CRISPR off-target prediction
definition: Identify and score genomic loci susceptible to unintended cleavage based on sequence similarity to a CRISPR guide RNA.

label: CRISPR screen analysis
definition: Identify genes affecting phenotype or fitness from guide RNA abundance changes in a pooled CRISPR library screen.

label: Demographic modeling
definition: Infer historical population size changes, divergence times, and migration rates from population genetic summary statistics.

label: Direct RNA base modification detection
definition: Detect RNA base modifications directly from nanopore ionic current signal without chemical conversion.

label: Doublet/multiplet detection
definition: Identify barcodes representing co-encapsulated multiple cells rather than single cells in single-cell sequencing data.

label: Full-length isoform analysis
definition: Characterize complete transcript isoforms, including alternative splicing events and novel transcripts, from long-read sequencing data.

label: Functional genomics analysis
definition: Large-scale analysis of the functional consequences of genomic elements or variants using systematic perturbation experiments.

label: Functional metagenomic prediction
definition: Infer the functional gene content and metabolic pathway potential of a microbial community from its taxonomic composition or metagenomic sequences.

label: Gene fusion detection
definition: Identify chimeric transcripts from chromosomal rearrangements or trans-splicing in RNA-seq data, or gene-fusing structural variants from genome sequencing.

label: Genome editing analysis
definition: Design and computational analysis of experiments using programmable nucleases to introduce targeted modifications to genomic DNA.

label: Genome editing outcome analysis
definition: Quantify insertions, deletions, and precise editing outcomes at a CRISPR target locus from amplicon sequencing data.

label: Genome-wide association analysis
definition: Test statistical associations between genetic variants across the genome and a phenotypic trait to identify loci that influence the trait.

label: Guide RNA design
definition: Design and score guide RNA sequences for CRISPR genome editing, optimizing for on-target activity and off-target specificity.

label: Haplotype-resolved assembly
definition: Produce a phased genome assembly representing each haplotype as a separate contiguous sequence.

label: Hyperparameter optimization
definition: Search the configuration space of a machine learning model to identify hyperparameter settings that maximize held-out predictive performance.

label: Long-read assembly polishing
definition: Correct systematic sequence errors in a draft assembly using additional sequencing reads.

label: Machine learning
definition: Computational methods that train, evaluate, or apply statistical models learned from biological data.

label: Machine learning model training
definition: Fit a machine learning model to a training dataset by minimizing a loss function to produce a parameterized model.

label: Metagenome-assembled genome (MAG) analysis
definition: Recover, assess quality (completeness and contamination), and taxonomically classify genome bins assembled from shotgun metagenomic data.

label: Microbial differential abundance analysis
definition: Identify microbial taxa significantly differentially abundant between conditions using models that account for compositional data.

label: Microbiome analysis
definition: Analysis of microbial community composition and function from metagenomic or marker-gene amplicon sequencing data.

label: Model cross-validation and evaluation
definition: Assess machine learning model performance on held-out data using cross-validation procedures.

label: Multi-omics analysis
definition: Integrated analysis of two or more omics modalities from the same samples to identify coordinated patterns of variation.

label: Multi-omics data integration
definition: Combine and jointly analyze datasets from two or more omics layers using latent variable, network, or matrix factorization approaches.

label: Multi-omics factor analysis
definition: Decompose multi-omics datasets into shared and dataset-specific latent factors capturing coordinated biological variation.

label: Neural network inference
definition: Apply a trained neural network to new input data to generate predictions, classifications, or embeddings without updating model parameters.

label: OTU/ASV generation
definition: Cluster amplicon sequencing reads into operational taxonomic units (OTUs) or denoise them into exact amplicon sequence variants (ASVs) to represent distinct microbial taxa.

label: Polygenic score calculation
definition: Aggregate per-allele effects of genome-wide variants into a score predicting an individual's genetic predisposition to a trait.

label: Population differentiation calculation
definition: Calculate allele frequency-based statistics that quantify genetic differentiation between populations, such as FST or PBS.

label: Population genetics analysis
definition: Statistical analysis of genetic variation across populations to infer demographic history, population structure, selection pressures, and genotype-phenotype associations.

label: Population structure analysis
definition: Infer ancestral population structure and assign individuals to clusters from genome-wide variant data.

label: RNA velocity analysis
definition: Estimate the future transcriptional state of cells by modeling RNA splicing kinetics from unspliced-to-spliced transcript ratios.

label: Runs of homozygosity analysis
definition: Detect extended genomic segments of continuous homozygosity indicative of inbreeding, autozygosity, or positive selection sweeps.

label: Selective sweep analysis
definition: Detect genomic signatures of recent positive selection using haplotype-based statistics or allele frequency methods.

label: Single-cell analysis
definition: Analysis of molecular measurements made at the resolution of individual cells.

label: Single-cell data integration
definition: Harmonize single-cell datasets from different batches or technologies into a common embedding preserving biological variation.

label: Single-cell multiomics analysis
definition: Jointly analyze two or more molecular modalities measured simultaneously in the same individual cells.

label: Spatial domain identification
definition: Partition a tissue section into spatially coherent regions with distinct molecular signatures.

label: Spatial gene expression analysis
definition: Process and analyze spatially resolved transcriptomic data to link gene expression measurements to physical coordinates within a tissue section.

label: Spatial neighborhood analysis
definition: Characterize the molecular composition and cell type enrichment of the local microenvironment around each cell or spot in spatial transcriptomic data.

label: Spatial omics analysis
definition: Analysis of molecular profiling data that retains spatial coordinates within a tissue section.

label: Spatial spot/cell deconvolution
definition: Estimate the cell type composition of each spatial capture unit using a single-cell reference expression atlas.

label: Spatially variable gene detection
definition: Identify genes whose expression varies significantly across tissue space in spatially resolved transcriptomic data.

label: Topologically associating domain (TAD) identification
definition: Partition the genome into self-interacting chromatin domains (TADs) separated by boundary regions of reduced contact frequency.

label: Trajectory inference
definition: Order cells along a continuous or branching path representing a biological process, inferring pseudotemporal progression from single-cell expression data.

label: Transcription factor footprinting
definition: Identify transcription factor occupancy events from characteristic protection patterns within ATAC-seq or DNase-seq chromatin accessibility data.

label: Transfer learning
definition: Adapt a machine learning model pre-trained on large biological datasets to a new prediction task by continued training on a smaller, task-specific dataset.

label: UMI deduplication
definition: Collapse PCR duplicate reads sharing identical cell barcodes and UMIs to a single molecule count.
